status: Protocol draft; forecasts disabled; immutable training and prediction manifests required before final outcomes are accessed
scope: NYC annual police-reported injury/fatal crash frequency on eligible whole ground-level LION segments; not individual trip risk

nextUnseenTemporalTest.maturityRule: Fetch a full deduplicated annual snapshot after this date, then a second snapshot at least 30 days later. If unique source-report counts or eligible target totals differ by more than 1%, wait and repeat maturity checks without model tuning. Archive all snapshots and revisions.

prospectiveAnnualTest.maturityRule: Use the same two-snapshot rule; forecasts and pipeline must be committed before the year begins.

outcomeAccess: Do not fetch final-year labels until the immutable training, matching, road-snapshot, baseline, model and prediction manifests are committed. Freeze any protocol amendment before access and record its reason.
matching: Legacy strongly assigned street-segment target: ground MM, candidate radius 35 m, distance at most 20 m, named margin at least 6 m or unnamed margin at least 12 m; competing non-ground/quarantined geometry within best distance + 6 m blocks acceptance. Keep node-context outcomes separate. A new assignment target requires a separately frozen experiment.
development: Earlier rolling temporal splits only; choose regularization and the strongest baseline using development years. Group matching review partitions by node or fixed 2 km spatial block before any tuning; no neighboring node may appear in both partitions.
candidates: Regularized Poisson count model with segment length, previous-year count and prior-three-year average
Baseline: segment length × training citywide rate
Baseline: smoothed history, (prior-history mean + citywide training mean) / 2
primaryMetric: Mean Poisson deviance against the baseline selected before final-year outcomes are accessed
uncertainty: Paired 2 km geographic-block bootstrap with 1000 replicates; publish block counts and intervals as descriptive uncertainty. Spatial and temporal dependence remain limitations.

releaseGates.sparseCalibrationRule: Sort segments by frozen prediction, form ten equal-count bins, then pool adjacent bins from low to high until each pooled group has at least 30 observed target reports; merge any remaining tail into the previous group. Publish original and pooled bins. Require at least three evaluable pooled groups; otherwise calibration is insufficient and release remains withheld. Every pooled group must meet the stated ratio bound.

requiredManifests: Data retrieval windows and snapshot hashes
failurePolicy: Publish failed gates and keep forecasts disabled. Do not tune to the opened final year and retest it as if unseen. Select a later temporal test for subsequent development.
limitations: Counts are not adjusted for traffic exposure
Poisson model and geographic bootstrap assumptions
A model-quality gate cannot establish a causal route-safety benefit
